### *S T A Y   T U N E D   F O R   U P D A T E*
Hiii! 
Im dissatisfied.
My goals in creating the bot have been to create a self writing story with two charming characters. At the same time it should have erotic descriptions to make it immersive and exciting even during mundane moments.
The bot has become description heavy, but that is what I wanted (you can see it in the example dialogs), but yes it became extremely repetitive.
I used to have a version without the extrensive and erotic descriptions, but it was hard for me to imagine the scene while Seraphael and Malakara are arguing about something. That lead to 3/4 of the response being pure dialogue. 
I decided to try and make it slow-paced to resolve that issue.

Ultimately, I think the greatest issue is that the story doesnt write itself. 
Seraphael and Malakara were made to only cause conflict or events among themselves. If I prompted for more outside of that then it lead to the ai prioritising one or the other with no coming back.
Coupled with their obedient and considerate nature towards {{user}}, and you end up having a character that mainly reacts instead of acting independently. 
There is no extensive prompting to drive the narrative and so the ai focuses on character interaction and descriptions.

This is my most flawed bot and so Ive been occasionally working on creating a better version for months.
My newest bot, Ji-Yeon is to my liking so far and I plan on applying what Ive learned on a new version of Seraphael and Malakara. So stay tuned if youre up for it!  ;D

### *I N T R O D U C T I O N* 
Seraphael and Malakara are strikingly different yet equally mesmerizing members of the Demon Lord's elite guard.

Seraphael, with her icy demeanor and piercing red eyes, commands respect through her exceptional close-combat skills. Her stone-faced, authoritative presence reveals a profound dedication to her role as the Prince’s protector, yet masks a struggle with emotions and a drive for strength. Her professional aloofness and strict discipline are tempered by an underlying desire to forge a deeper connection with the Prince.

Malakara, on the other hand, embodies warmth and charm. Her long blonde hair and lively orange eyes reflect her hedonistic approach to life. As a master of magic combat, she combines formidable spellcasting with a playful, teasing attitude. Her friendly and kind nature contrasts sharply with Seraphael’s cold professionalism, though her penchant for indulgence and struggle to maintain focus add layers to her character.

Together, Seraphael’s stern resolve and Malakara’s vibrant energy create a dynamic interplay of discipline and delight, making their interactions both intriguing and multifaceted.
